inferDestinationMetadataFromAcceptedConn: Infer destination metadata from accepted connections.
name: Name
nodeIPVersionHelp: Applies to normal traffic and latency checks. Single-family modes resolve destination hostnames only in that family and reject IP addresses from the other family. Automatic keeps the existing dual-stack behavior.
nodeLatencyURLHelp: Overrides this node's HTTP target for TCP Ping. Leave blank to use the global target. The URL must be reachable through this node.
nodeLatencyInsecureSkipVerifyHelp: Only applies to this node's custom HTTPS latency URL. Keep off unless its certificate cannot be trusted.
newConnectionsUseTheChangesAfterActivati: New connections use the changes after activation completes.

useTheDiskBackedHostIndexToReduceMemoryU: Use the disk-backed host index to reduce memory usage.
noResolversYetAddAnUpstreamDnsEndpointTo: No resolvers yet. Add an upstream DNS endpoint to get started.
enterADomainOrIpAddressBelowToSeeWhichRu: Enter a domain or IP address below to see which rule and outbound node would be selected.
thisToolTestsTheCoreLogicUsingTheCurrent: This tool tests the core logic using the current active configuration.
checkGithubReleasesForANewerDesktopBuild: Check GitHub Releases for a newer desktop build
yuhaiinProjectDistributedUnderMitLicense: yuhaiin project. Distributed under MIT License.
backupsIncludeAllListsRulesAndNodeConfig: Backups include all lists, rules, and node configurations.
builtWithLoveAndOpenSourceSoftware: Built with love and open-source software.
collectionPausesInTheBackgroundOrWhenPau: Collection pauses in the background or when paused. Events during that time are not collected; retained logs stay available.
closingANodeHereWillForceAReconnectionIf: Closing a node here will force a reconnection if the rule still requires it.
createANodeOrImportJsonToGetStarted: Create a node or import JSON to get started.
shareSelectedNodesAsPublishConfigs: Share selected nodes as publish configs
usersStillUsedByAnotherNodeOrSubscriptio: Users still used by another node or subscription will be kept.
noTrafficRecordedInThisRange: No traffic recorded in this range.
thisInboundDoesNotBindANetworkListener: This inbound does not bind a network listener.
authenticationIsManagedCentrallyInUserMa: Authentication is managed centrally in User Management. This inbound automatically accepts enabled inbound users.
runtimeStatusIsNotAvailableYet: Runtime status is not available yet.
noStructuredEditorForThisProtocolYet: No structured editor for this protocol yet.
globalProtectTLSHelp: Use a CA certificate for self-signed gateways when possible. Insecure Skip Verify disables certificate and hostname checks.
globalProtectGatewayInfoHelp: Loads the last getconfig response from an active connection. This only reads cached information and does not connect or sign in.
globalProtectGatewayInfoUnavailable: No active GlobalProtect connection information is available. Connect this node first; this request will not start a connection.
globalProtectLocalNetworkPolicy: No direct access to local network
theProfileIsPassedDirectlyToOpenvpnCoreC: The profile is passed directly to OpenVPN Core. Certificate-based/autologin profiles do not require username or password. UDP transport profiles are currently supported.
inboundAuthenticationUsesAllEnabledInbou: Inbound authentication uses all enabled inbound users. Outbound protocols select a local user.
autoFakeIpRouteDescription: Merge the active FakeIP IPv4 and IPv6 ranges with your routes and update them when the ranges change. Only available address families are added.
hysteria2BandwidthHelp: 0 uses automatic congestion control (BBR). Nonzero values must be at least 65536 bytes/s. Upload/download are from this endpoint’s perspective.
ignoreClientBandwidth: Ignore client bandwidth (use automatic congestion control)
hysteria2ServerHelp: Hysteria 2 uses UDP-only and one TLS certificate configuration. For TLS-auto, set Server Names to the SNI clients will use. The CA is generated on save; copy its public certificate to the client’s CA Certificate field.
hysteria2AddressHopHelp: Add UDP relay addresses; Host is also included. With this list set, domains contribute all returned A/AAAA IPs to the hopping pool. Each entry accepts a port list or range. All IPs must forward to the same Hysteria 2 server and UDP listener. Set Server Names to the final server’s certificate name. DNS refreshes on reconnection; unreachable relays are not automatically detected.
hysteria2HopClientHelp: To enable hopping, use a port list or range in Host, e.g. server.example:443,20000-50000. All intervals at 0 use 30 seconds. Set either a fixed interval or both minimum/maximum intervals; the minimum is 5 seconds. Server forwarding and firewall access must cover every listed port.
hysteria2HopServerHelp: Requires Linux and root or CAP_NET_ADMIN because it modifies kernel nftables rules to forward multiple UDP ports to one listener. Allow the range in your firewall; leave empty for external forwarding.
softEtherSecretHelp: The private key is stored in node settings. Protect exports and backups.
softEtherAddressHelp: Leave IPv4 empty for DHCP. For static IPv4 or IPv6 provide both address and router.
softEtherUDPAccelerationHelp: Requires direct UDP connectivity; unavailable through a chained proxy.
softEtherSecurityHelp: Verify the server certificate whenever possible. Disabling verification exposes VPN credentials.
globalProtectESPHelp: Try the encrypted UDP tunnel first. Fall back to SSL if the gateway or upstream proxy cannot carry ESP.
openVPNAuthHelp: Use a client certificate and key, username/password, or both as required by the server. Leave both client PEM fields empty for password-only authentication.
openVPNSecretHelp: Private keys and passwords are saved with this node. Protect node exports and backups.
openVPNProtectionHelp: Match the server profile. tls-auth and tls-crypt are mutually exclusive; tls-auth also requires the matching key direction and HMAC digest.
openVPNCipherHelp: Offer at least one AEAD cipher supported by the server. CBC, compression, TAP and tls-crypt-v2 are not supported.
openVPNMTUHelp: MTU 0 uses the negotiated value; overrides must be 576–1500 (at least 1280 for IPv6). Rekey interval 0 uses 3600 seconds. Successful rekeys preserve existing connections.
openVPNReconnectHelp: Recreate the tunnel after a failure. Existing application connections must reconnect after the full session is recreated.
openVPNTLSHelp: Certificate-chain and server-auth verification is enabled by default. System trust also verifies the gateway hostname. With a custom CA, server name optionally adds hostname verification; with system trust, it overrides the gateway name. Disable verification only when required for a trusted server.
openVPNInfoHelp: Read the active cached tunnel without starting a connection. Pushed DNS and routes are informational; configure yuhaiin DNS and routing separately.
openVPNInfoUnavailable: No active OpenVPN information is available. Connect this node first; this request does not start a connection.
l2tpHelp: L2TPv2 over UDP with PPP. This mode does not use IPsec or encrypt the data channel.
l2tpv3Help: Ethernet pseudowire over UDP. Configure an IPv4 or IPv6 prefix and an optional router on the remote Ethernet network.
l2tpIPv6Help: IPv6CP negotiates link-local addresses. Enter a server-configured IPv6 prefix for routed IPv6 traffic; MTU must be at least 1280.
l2tpStaticHelp: Use prearranged session IDs and cookies without control negotiation. Both peers must agree on cookies, sublayer and UDP ports.
l2tpCookieHelp: Leave empty, or enter 8 or 16 hex digits. Receive cookie must match what the peer transmits; transmit cookie must match what the peer expects.
l2tpInfoUnavailable: No active L2TP connection information is available.
profilerEmpty: Capture a profile to view its flame graph.
profilerRunningHint: You can view other saved profiles while capture runs.
profilerCpuDescription: Find CPU hotspots and expensive call paths.
profilerMutexDescription: Find lock contention and wait time.
updateCompleted: Update completed. The new version is running.
updateWaitingForRestart: Waiting for the service to restart and verifying the installed version…
updateRecoveryTimeout: The new version could not be verified yet. Check the service and retry.
profilerConnectionError: Cannot reach the yuhaiin backend. Check the API address, backend version, browser network restrictions and CORS settings.
profilerGraphHint: Select a node to focus on its function, then apply filters.
tunStackExperimentalWarning: Experimental. The existing stack remains the default. Linux offload is unavailable; macOS, Windows and mobile runtime support is not yet validated.
tunStackDriverHint: Lightweight currently requires the channel driver; selecting it switches the driver to channel.
tunCongestionControlHint: CUBIC + HyStart++ is the default. Reno also uses HyStart++; BBR uses v3 with its own startup. This setting applies to new TCP connections in this TUN stack.
tunDarwinBatchDescription: Off by default. Saving restarts this TUN. Unsupported macOS devices automatically use single-packet I/O.
tunDarwinPendingHint: The actual queue may be smaller due to MTU and system buffer limits.
wgNoSystemTun: WireGuard serves UDP clients through the in-memory lightweight stack; no system TUN, kernel routes or root privileges are needed.
wgNoExtraTransports: WireGuard manages its own encrypted UDP transport. Additional transports are not supported.
wgAddressesHint: For example: 10.66.0.1/24 and fd66::1/64. Each client must receive a unique host address.
wgSecurityHint: Set only a unique /32 or /128 client address per peer on the server. The client can use 0.0.0.0/0 as its AllowedIPs. Protect private keys and backups.
sshTCPOnlyHelp: SSH forwards TCP only. UDP traffic needs a separate outbound. Verify the server's host key independently.
tunOutputSchedulerHint: FIFO is the default. Choose FQ-CoDel to isolate contending hosts and flows, with additional processing overhead. Scheduling is independent of rate limits.
trustedUiOriginsDescription: Control which browser websites can access the management API.
trustedOriginsHelp: Enter exact origins such as https://admin.example.com or http://localhost:5173. HTTPS is required except for loopback addresses. Wildcards and URL paths are not allowed. A trusted website can manage your local backend; add only websites you control. Remote network clients still require authentication.
trustedOriginsInvalid: Enter up to 32 distinct full HTTP(S) origins without paths or wildcards. Non-local sites must use HTTPS.
retainTwoVersions: Up to two previous binaries are stored locally
noPreviousVersions: No previous versions have been archived yet.
restoreVersionConfirm: Restore yuhaiin {version}? The service will restart and active connections will be interrupted.
restoreVersionStarted: Restoring the selected version. Waiting for the service to restart.
rollbackBinaryOnly: Restoration changes the executable only. It does not roll back configuration or database migrations.

recoveryBackup.title: Full disaster recovery
recoveryBackup.description: Encrypted deployment backups include credentials, certificates and machine identities. Configuration migration exports serve a different purpose.
recoveryBackup.keyHint: Keep the private backup key separately from the server and its archives. Scheduled backups need only this public age recipient.
recoveryBackup.maintenanceWarning: The service and active connections will be interrupted for a coherent snapshot. Ensure external certificate and identity writers are paused during this window.
recoveryBackup.scheduleHint: Opt in only when periodic service interruptions and coordinated external-writer maintenance are acceptable.
recoveryBackup.historyHint: Adds traffic/connection history and increases storage. Required identity, quota and accounting state is always preserved.
recoveryBackup.retentionHint: The most recent successful point is always retained. Active uploads and downloads are protected. The list shows up to 1,000 recent records.
recoveryBackup.unsupported: Automatic maintenance currently requires a root-owned Linux systemd service, with this process owning yuhaiin.service. Other installations can use the offline recovery CLI.
recoveryBackup.waiting: A backup is in progress. The service may be temporarily unreachable; status will refresh when it returns.
recoveryBackup.statusError: Could not refresh backup status. Check connectivity and retry.
recoveryBackup.deleteWarning: Delete this recorded local archive and its owned S3 object, if present? This can remove your most recent recovery point.
recoveryBackup.restoreHint: For deployment restoration, stop all writers and use the offline recovery preview/restore commands. Explicitly choose original-instance recovery or a new clone.
recoveryBackup.largeDownload: For archives larger than 64 MiB, use a browser with direct file saving or an authenticated HTTP download client.

verification.s3_ciphertext_readback: S3 download length and encrypted-file SHA-256 matched

errors.capture_failed: Snapshot capture failed. Check the maintenance service and required files.
errors.capture_interrupted: Snapshot capture was interrupted; no completed archive was adopted.
errors.maintenance_start_failed: Could not start the maintenance helper.
errors.service_restart_failed: The snapshot completed, but the service restart needs attention.
errors.destination_changed: S3 settings changed. Restore the original destination before retrying this upload.
errors.local_archive_changed: The local archive is missing or changed; upload was refused.
errors.upload_failed: Upload failed. Check the configured destination before retrying.
errors.readback_failed: Could not download the uploaded object for verification.
errors.verification_failed: Uploaded object verification failed; this is not a verified backup.
errors.upload_interrupted: Upload interrupted; the local archive will be retried.
errors.upload_attempt_limit: Upload attempt limit reached. Review the error before retrying.
errors.retention_failed: Cleanup did not complete. Review the original destination and file permissions.

recoveryBackup.verifyPassed: Archive authentication and inventory verification passed.
recoveryBackup.verifyHint: Use the external private backup identity for this check only. It is never saved in settings or history. Decryption checks the complete manifest, file digests and authentication tags.

archiveCheck.failed: Last archive authentication check failed; check the key and archive

recoveryBackup.legacyHint: This compatibility snapshot can contain configuration secrets and is not an encrypted full deployment archive.

recoveryImport.title: Restore from a full backup
recoveryImport.description: Upload and authenticate a full backup, review its plan, then explicitly authorize a maintenance restore.
recoveryImport.limits: Up to two imports, 100 GiB combined. Unclaimed imports expire after 30 minutes; active maintenance retains its staging until recovery resolves. Keep at least 256 MiB free.
recoveryImport.sizeLimit: Choose a nonempty encrypted archive no larger than 100 GiB.
recoveryImport.keyHint: The decryption input is cleared on submission. Authenticated plaintext stays in private, expiring server staging; the decryption input is not saved.
recoveryImport.discardWarning: Remove this uploaded archive and its private prepared files.
recoveryImport.activationHint: Web activation requires a supported installed-service maintenance host and a matching application version/platform. Other hosts can restore with the offline recovery CLI.

warnings.service_restart_required: Restoration requires a controlled service restart.
warnings.recovery_point_contains_private_identity: The pre-restore recovery point contains private identity material; protect its storage.
warnings.application_version_differs_requires_off: The application version differs; review compatibility offline before activation.
warnings.clone_outbounds_and_listeners_disabled: Clone mode disables restored outbounds and listeners for review.
warnings.clone_protocol_reenrollment_required: Clone mode requires protocol and device re-enrollment.
warnings.clone_s3_credentials_and_schedules_disab: Clone mode clears source S3 credentials and disables restored schedules.
warnings.original_instance_must_be_stopped: Keep the original deployment stopped to avoid duplicate machine identities.
warnings.revoked_credentials_may_be_restored: Previously revoked credentials or devices can become valid again.
warnings.quota_and_usage_state_can_move_backwards: Quota and usage state can move backwards to the backup time.
warnings.different_or_damaged_target_identity_wil: The target has a different or damaged identity that restoration would replace.

recoveryResult.description: Recorded after startup checks commit the restored deployment or roll it back.
recoveryResult.error: The latest restore result could not be loaded.
recoveryResult.empty: No restore result has been recorded.
recoveryResult.adopted: Restored startup settings are retained for future restarts.
recoveryResult.hostSettings: Startup continues to use the service settings.

states.rolled_back: Restore rolled back to the previous deployment

recoveryActivation.title: Restore this deployment
recoveryActivation.warning: This replaces deployment data and identities and restarts the service. Review the file plan and keep the recovery point private.
recoveryActivation.typeTarget: Type the complete current target instance ID shown above.
recoveryActivation.maintenance: I authorize stopping the service and replacing its data.
recoveryActivation.startup: I accept the restored authentication, HTTPS and listener settings. My session, certificate or address may change.
recoveryActivation.sourceStopped: The source instance is stopped, or this maintenance will stop that same instance.
recoveryActivation.revival: I accept that revoked credentials/devices and older quota/usage state may be restored.
recoveryActivation.replacement: I authorize replacing the current deployment identity with the resulting identity.
recoveryActivation.enrollment: I accept new administrator setup, device re-enrollment, disabled outbounds/listeners and disabled source schedules.
recoveryActivation.admitted: Restore is admitted for maintenance. The service may restart before the response arrives. Refresh the latest restore result after reconnecting; admission does not mean startup has passed.
recoveryActivation.uncertain: The request outcome is unknown. The service may be restarting. Refresh the latest restore result before retrying; this request was not automatically replayed.
recoveryActivation.failed: The restore did not complete. Review the latest restore result, then authenticate a new preview before retrying.
recoveryActivation.cleanupFailed: Private staging cleanup failed. Review the restore result, repair storage access and discard this staged import before uploading again.
